		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }

			if = {
				limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1 } }

					}

							construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_foundation cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
						}

								building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_foundation
								value = 1
								owner = prev
							}

				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						prev = {
							var:tv_wonder_foundation_units ?= { this >= 2 }
							var:tv_wonder_level ?= 0
						}
						NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_foundation value >= 2 } }
